messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: high error rate (504/502) for Orpheus Systems - private VPC deployment (private-orpheus-prod) — ingress healthchecks failing on ALB -> NLB path. Trigger: 5m error rate > 8%
PagerDuty: Paging Samir Khatri (on-call) — escalation to EngSRE after 3m
Samir Khatri: on it. joining huddle in #incident-war-room — starting triage. Can someone paste patient customer impact numbers? :eyes:
Morgan Lee: Ava from Orpheus already posted that they see 15% of requests failing with 502s, from their side the gateway shows upstream "connection reset" errors. They've opened a support case, customer notified.
Jess Huang: Noted. Loading recent deploys — I see a config rollout 02:18 for private-orpheus-prod that updated security group rules on the ALB subnets (`sg-0a1b2c3d allow 10.0.0.0/16:443`) and added an explicit deny for 0.0.0.0/0:1024-65535 for a tenant isolation rule.
Diego Ramos: That deny range looks suspicious. ALB healthchecks originate from NLB health-proxy on ephemeral ports in that range. Could be the healthcheck traffic being blocked.
Samir Khatri: Good call. Can someone confirm SG change diff and who pushed it?
Jess Huang: Rolling diff from deploy service:
```
- sg-0a1b2c3d: ingress ALLOW tcp 1024-65535 from 0.0.0.0/0 --> REMOVED
+ sg-0a1b2c3d: ingress DENY tcp 1024-65535 from 0.0.0.0/0 --> ADDED
```
Author: infra-config-bot, pipeline: tenant-isolation-v2
Samir Khatri: Oof. That would explain asymmetric behavior: ALB healthchecks to NLB use ephemeral ports and are now dropped. Need quick mitigation: revert SG change or add explicit allow for healthcheck source. What's fastest?
Morgan Lee: Customer is sensitive to a full rollback; prefer narrow allow. We can add allow from our NLB health IPs/eni range — but for Orpheus this is a private deployment, we have known health-check CIDR set: 10.8.128.0/24 (internal).
Ava (Customer: Orpheus Systems): Confirmed we don't have any changes on our side. We went green until ~02:20, then small spikes and now 15% failing. Please keep me posted.
Diego Ramos: I'll add emergency rule to sg-0a1b2c3d to allow tcp 1024-65535 from 10.8.128.0/24. Patch command:
```
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0a1b2c3d --protocol tcp --port 1024-65535 --cidr 10.8.128.0/24
```
Applying now.
NOC-Bot: change-approved by Samir Khatri, change-id CHG-20260315-001, scheduled immediate apply.
Jess Huang: Applied. Please confirm healthchecks from ALB -> NLB are succeeding — monitoring panels updating...
Samir Khatri: Monitoring logs: healthcheck success rate jumping from 60% -> 98% in the last 30s. Error rate on ingress path falling.
Ava (Customer: Orpheus Systems): Thank you — errors dropped dramatically. We're seeing normal traffic now. Any ETA on permanent fix?
Samir Khatri: Immediate mitigation is the narrow allow. We'll coordinate a safer permanent config: either revert the deny or change the tenant-isolation rule to exclude healthcheck CIDRs by default.
Jess Huang: Root cause: infra-config-bot rolled tenant-isolation-v2 which introduced a broad deny that didn't account for internal healthcheck ephemeral ports. Remediation plan: (1) Update config generator to include healthcheck CIDRs in exclusion list, (2) add test in CI that simulates ALB->NLB healthcheck ports, (3) create runbook entry.
Morgan Lee: Customer comms: I'll send a short note to Ava summarizing cause and mitigation, and offer a follow-up postmortem.
Ava (Customer: Orpheus Systems): Appreciate it. Please include timeline and any potential for recurrence.
Samir Khatri: Handoff: my shift ends in 20m — passing to Diego who will own next 4h. Diego please ACK and verify nothing else pending (rollbacks, DOC, monitoring).
Diego Ramos: ACK. I'll keep the change and monitor for 2 hours, then we schedule the infra fix in staging. Also will add a spike alert for ephemeral port drops.
PagerDuty: Samir acknowledged at 1768504385, incident severity set to sev2, channel updated.
Samir Khatri: Quick check: any other customers on the same tenant-isolation-v2 tag that could be impacted? Jess?
Jess Huang: Running a query — ~6 private customers have that config. I see 1 more reporting intermittent 503s (tenant-id: zeta-392). I'll open separate thread but tagging this for correlation.
Morgan Lee: Next steps tracked in ticket: INFRA-9876. Owner: Diego Ramos. Customer update sent at 02:32 UTC.
Samir Khatri: Good work team. Postmortem owner: Jess. Please include timeline, config diff, and why the CI check didn't catch this.
Diego Ramos: Leaving note in doc and will follow up on config generator patch. I'll also propose a small conservative default rule that preserves ephemeral port ranges for healthchecks.
Ava (Customer: Orpheus Systems): Thanks everyone for the quick response. We'll stay on stand-by for the follow-up.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: error rate returned to baseline, customer confirmed. Incident duration ~00:40. Severity: S2.
Samir Khatri: We're closing the Slack thread — moving to postmortem doc. If anything flares, re-open here. :white_check_mark:
